name: PowerShell — Suspicious Execution Keywords Detected
description: Detects PowerShell Script Block Logging events (Event ID 4104) containing keywords commonly associated with post-exploitation activity: remote code execution, payload download, execution policy bypass, encoded commands, and reverse shell establishment. Script Block Logging captures the full content of executed PowerShell at runtime, enabling detection of malicious use even when the script is obfuscated or run interactively. Triggers on any of: Invoke-Expression, IEX, DownloadString, DownloadFile, TCPClient, EncodedCommand, -enc, -nop, bypass, FromBase64String, Net.WebClient.
query: event.code: "4104" and process.name: "powershell.exe" and (powershell.file.script_block_text: "Invoke-Expression" or powershell.file.script_block_text: "IEX" or powershell.file.script_block_text: "DownloadString" or powershell.file.script_block_text: "DownloadFile" or powershell.file.script_block_text: "TCPClient" or powershell.file.script_block_text: "EncodedCommand" or powershell.file.script_block_text: "-enc" or powershell.file.script_block_text: "bypass" or powershell.file.script_block_text: "FromBase64String" or powershell.file.script_block_text: "Net.WebClient")
author: Noel Biju John
